mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increased for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month signals an improving labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3 percentage points in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over two consecutive months signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declined for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) relative to GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS/GDPC1 is above its historical median.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) over two consecutive months signals a robust labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 200 indicates high inflation, which, in a tightening monetary regime, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased uncertainty and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL is above 200 during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of increasing real GDP (GDPC1) and decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a quarter signals a strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and UNRATE decreases over 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 increased and UNRATE decreased over the previous quarter.
